guidance.heading: Outlook
section: “We believe we are positioned to continue delivering growth and executing on our diversification strategy. Project Catalyst, which is our comprehensive plan designed to further optimize our asset base and create a more productive and agile organization, is contributing to this growth," said Luis E. Rojo, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Despite the ongoing and significant market uncertainties and challenges, the organization continues to be focused on executing our growth opportunities, productivity plans and cash interventions. With these actions and the strong first nine-month results, we believe we will deliver full year Adjusted EBITDA growth, positive free cash flow and continue to de-leverage the balance sheet in 2026."
